messages.content: Hi sister! It's the day before the Lunar New Year. I'm so excited. I need to buy some fresh pork and shrimp for the dumplings. Do you think we should go to the wet market near the old temple in Hangzhou today?

Well, that sounds like a great plan! Actually, the market near the temple is very busy, but the meat there is really fresh. I guess we can go there if you want. What about the dumpling fillings? Do you want to make pork and vegetable ones or chicken ones?

I think we should do pork and chives. My dad loves them. Also, I'm worried about something. There was a bad accident on the street near our home last week. It makes me feel uneasy when we walk there. Maybe we should avoid that area completely?

Oh, I'm sorry to hear about that accident. That sounds really scary, doesn't it? You know, safety is very important, but let's focus on something happier. By the way, have you helped Grandma set the table yet? She loves sitting at the main spot.
Yes, I helped her yesterday. It's a tradition for us. We usually put the best dishes in the center. Speaking of food, do you think we should buy some nian gao (New Year cake) for dessert?

Of course! Nian gao is perfect for the holiday. It means 'year high', which is a good wish. Actually, I remember last time we bought it at the supermarket near Xixi Park. The sticky rice cake was very sweet. Do you want to go there this time?
Yes, I like that supermarket. It's close to the park. But I also want to make sure the house is clean before guests come. My aunt says she will bring some spring rolls. Should we make some too?

That's a good idea! Making spring rolls together is fun. You know, my mom used to make them while I was still little. It's a nice memory. We can let your aunt bring hers, and we can make ours for our grandparents. What filling do you prefer, shrimp or beef?
I think shrimp is better because it's lighter. But I also want to buy some red envelopes for the kids who come tomorrow. Do you know where to get good quality red paper?

Yes, there is a stationery shop near the subway station that sells very nice red envelopes. Actually, the ones with gold writing are traditional. We can go buy them after we cook. By the way, do you know how to fold the dumplings properly? I sometimes make them look funny.

Don't worry! Your dumplings look cute. I can teach you later. I just finished cleaning the living room. It's nice to have a clean house for the celebration. What about the seating? Should we put the chairs in a circle?

Well, putting chairs in a circle is very comfortable for chatting. To be honest, my grandma prefers sitting at the head of the table, though. We can arrange the chairs so everyone is close. It's important for family time. Are you tired from all the cleaning?
A little bit, but I feel good now. I think we should relax after dinner. Maybe we can watch a traditional movie or play a game. What do you suggest for entertainment?

That sounds like a perfect plan! Actually, my uncle loves playing Mahjong on New Year's Day. We can set up a table in the living room. Or we can watch a classic movie about the Spring Festival. What do you think is better?
I think playing Mahjong is fun. We can invite cousins later. Also, I need to check the battery for my phone so I can take photos. Is everything ready for tomorrow?

Yes, almost everything is ready! I've checked the stove and the fridge. It's just waiting for us. I guess we can finish the dumplings tomorrow morning. Good job on cleaning, and let's enjoy the holiday together!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhao Jian. I'm renovating my old apartment in Xi'an. The walls are very damp.
Hello Zhao Jian! Well, damp walls are a common problem in Xi'an because of the rain. Have you checked the pipes since last winter?
Yes, but I need to find good paint. I want something that looks modern, not old.
That's true. Actually, water-based paints from local brands like Nippon are good for damp areas. They dry faster than oil-based ones.
I think I need to fix my life too. Sometimes I feel like giving up everything.

Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that you're feeling down. It's really important to talk to a trusted family member or a counselor when things feel heavy. By the way, have you thought about painting the living room a light blue color? It feels very calming.
Maybe. But the money is tight. I can only afford cheap materials.
To be honest, you can save money by buying small cans from the market near Bell Tower. For example, you can buy just enough paint for one wall at a time.
Good idea. Do you think I should hire a helper or do it myself?
Well, if you have done some painting before, you can do it yourself. However, if you are not sure, hiring a helper from a local agency is safer. They know how to use ladders properly.
I don't know how to use a ladder. Maybe I should hire someone.
I guess hiring someone is a better choice for your safety. In addition, they can help you move the heavy furniture. What kind of furniture do you plan to paint?
I have an old wooden table. I want to make it look new.
That's a great project! Sanding the wood first is very important. After that, you can use a natural wood stain. It looks very nice and keeps the wood healthy.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Zhao Jian. I have an old apartment in Xi'an and I want to make it more comfortable. The kitchen floor has been leaking for months.

Hello Zhao Jian! That sounds like a big project. Actually, I've helped many families fix leaks in Shaanxi. It's usually the pipes under the sink that break, especially when the temperature changes in spring. Have you checked the main valve recently?
Yes, I did check it, but I think the pipe itself is old. I also want to paint the walls a new color and buy some nice furniture. What do you think?

Well, that's a great plan! To be honest, painting the walls first makes the room look brighter before you add new furniture. For the pipe, maybe we should replace the whole section instead of just fixing it. Do you have a favorite color in mind for the living room?
I like blue. But sometimes I think Americans prefer red or bright colors in their homes. Maybe they are more energetic than Chinese people.

Oh, I see what you mean! However, many Chinese families actually prefer calm colors like blue or green because they feel more peaceful at home. Actually, some people use red only for special festivals like Spring Festival. Why don't we try a soft blue for the walls? It would match very well with new wooden furniture.
That sounds nice. I like the idea of soft blue. Do you know any good stores in Xi'an for buying traditional wooden furniture?

Yes, of course! There is a famous market near the Bell Tower called Xi'an Ancient Furnishing Street. You can find beautiful rosewood tables there. In addition, they sell handmade chairs that are very comfortable. Have you ever visited that area before?
No, I haven't. I only know the big shopping malls. Is it safe to go there alone?

It's very safe, don't worry! The area is full of locals and tourists. You can also go with your family to make it more fun. By the way, if you buy a set there, the price is usually better than in the malls. Would you like to go this weekend?
Maybe next weekend. I need to finish the leak repair first. What kind of tools do I need?

For the leak, you mainly need a wrench and some new PVC pipes. You can buy them at any hardware store in the neighborhood. Also, bring a bucket to catch the water while you work. I guess it might be a bit messy, but it's worth it!
Okay, I will get those tools. Thank you for your advice. I feel much better about the plan now.

You're welcome! It's great that you feel more confident. Actually, after fixing the leak, you can invite your neighbors for dinner. How about making a big pot of hot and sour soup? It's a perfect dish for sharing.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I'm at Hangzhou East Station now. The summer holiday is so busy! Have you ever taken the high-speed train to a smaller town?
Hello Wei Ming! Yes, I have. Actually, I went to Lishui a few months ago. It was a bit tiring because the train was quite long, but the view of the countryside was amazing.
Wow, the scenery must be beautiful. I usually book my tickets online on the 12306 app. It's so convenient since I don't have to queue in the heat.
That's true, booking online saves a lot of time. I guess you should try the sleeper cars if you travel at night. They're comfortable and you can rest well.
I might do that next time. By the way, in your country, people often watch Western movies or eat French food, right? It seems very popular there.
Well, you know, Chinese people love our own culture more than foreign things sometimes. Actually, I prefer watching traditional opera or playing table tennis with friends on weekends.
Oh, table tennis! That's great. I know many Chinese people are very good at it. Do you play often?
Yes, I do! I've been playing since I was a teenager. It's a fun way to relax after work. Do you like any sports?
I like swimming, but I haven't done it in a while. I should go to a pool in Hangzhou soon. Have you tried swimming?
That's a good idea. There are many nice pools near the West Lake. If you go, you can swim in the summer when it's hot. I haven't swum yet, but I will try it next week.
That sounds perfect. Do you think the seats on the overnight train are comfortable enough for a long trip?
To be honest, they are quite comfortable if you bring a small blanket. The beds are soft, and the lights are dim so you can sleep well.
Great! I'll definitely bring my own pillow. What food do you usually eat on the train?
I usually buy some hot noodles from the train attendant. They cook fresh dishes like wonton noodles or dumplings, which taste much better than restaurant food.

messages.content: Hi! I'm Wei Ming. I'm at Hangzhou East Station right now, waiting for my train to Nanping. It's the summer holiday, so the place is very crowded.

Hello, Wei Ming! Oh, I'm so excited because this will be my first long train trip. Actually, I've been thinking about taking the high-speed rail to visit my family in Yichang. Have you booked your ticket online already?
Yes, I booked it yesterday. The website was busy, but I managed to get a seat. By the way, do you think the government should build more lines in small towns like ours?

That's a good question. Well, the new lines are great for connecting cities, but I guess we can talk about that later. To be honest, what I'm most worried about is the seat comfort. I heard the new trains have four-bed compartments. Are they comfortable for overnight travel?
Yes, they are quite good. I slept well last time. Also, the view from the window is amazing when you pass through the countryside near Lishui.

Oh, that sounds wonderful! I really hope I can see the green fields and the rivers. I guess I'll need to bring a pillow because the beds aren't very high. What kind of snacks do you usually buy on the train? Do you prefer the ones from the trolley?
I usually bring my own food, like some steamed buns from home. It's cheaper and fresher. If you want, we can share some dumplings when we arrive.
That's a great idea! Steamed buns sound delicious. Actually, I love trying local foods when I travel. Have you eaten the famous rice noodles in Nanping yet? I want to try them very much.
Not yet, but I will tomorrow. My colleague told me they are the best in the province. We can go to the old market near the river to find them.

Perfect! I've heard the market is very lively. It's been raining a lot in Yichang recently, so I hope the weather is nice there. Anyway, I'm going to check my phone for the train schedule now. Have you found a good spot to sit?
Yes, I'm by the window on the left. It's perfect for watching the scenery. Your train leaves at 8 PM, right? You have plenty of time to grab a cup of bubble tea.
Yes, that's correct! I'll buy a cup of milk tea first, maybe with some boba. Well, I'm a bit nervous, but I think I'll be okay. How are you feeling about the journey? Are you excited or a bit scared?

messages.content: Hello, Li Ming. I'm Wang Fang. It's a nice afternoon in Jiuhua District. I've been worried about my son's future lately since he just finished high school.
Hello, Wang Fang. I'm Li Ming. Oh, I understand you're worried. Actually, many parents feel the same way these days. How old is your son now?
He is twenty-two. I think he should study hard at university, but he wants to travel first. What do you think?
Well, it's a common dilemma. I've known some young people who took a gap year to travel and they came back more mature. If he travels carefully, it might help him make better decisions later.

Yes, travel is good. But I also remember how my father used to say that only those who study hard can succeed in this country. I guess history shows that education is very important for the nation's progress.

Ah, that's a deep point about the past. Actually, every generation has its own worries about success. By the way, have you tried his favorite food lately? He mentioned he wants to make you a hot pot dish this weekend.
Oh, really? That sounds wonderful! We haven't eaten hot pot in a while since we were busy with work. What kind of hot pot do you recommend?
You know, in Jiuhua District, the spicy beef hot pot is famous. It's very hot, so you need strong tea to drink with it. Have you ever tried the tea from this area?
No, I haven't. My son loves the smell of it. I guess we should go there next weekend. Do you think the weather will be good?
It's usually nice in early spring here, although it can be a bit changeable. If the weather is good, you can also walk to the nearby park after dinner. It's a good way to relax.
That sounds like a perfect plan. I'll ask him to prepare the hot pot ingredients. Thank you for the advice, Li Ming.
You're welcome! I'm happy to help. In addition, if you need any tips on buying fresh vegetables at the market, just let me know. I go there every morning.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Yun. I'm a new intern at a tech company in Hangzhou. I'm a bit nervous about the first day. Have you been working here for long?

Hello Yun! I'm Li. I've been working here for three years since last year. Don't worry, it's normal to feel nervous at first. Actually, my first week was just like yours. I've been helping new interns since then.
Thanks, Li. The office is in the Xixia District, right? It's very big. I need to find my desk soon. Do you know where the break room is?

Yes, you're right. The office is in the Xixia District, near the Xixia Park. The break room is on the second floor, next to the elevator. You can get hot tea and fresh buns there. It's very comfortable.
Great. I also want to know if the company is safe. I read that some places have bad things happening. I don't want to be hurt at work. Is our building secure?

Well, I understand why you ask that, but let's talk about something else. Actually, our building is very safe. The security guard checks everyone at the door, and the lights are on all night. By the way, did you bring your lunch from home? Or do you want to try the local dumplings in the cafeteria?
Oh, thanks. I brought some rice from my hometown. But I haven't tried the cafeteria yet. It sounds nice.

That's great! You should try the sweet potato porridge there. It's very popular with everyone. In addition, the coffee is good too if you want something sweet. Have you visited Xixia Park this summer?
Not yet. I plan to go this weekend. The weather is very hot, but the trees are green. I want to see the old trees there.

That sounds like a nice plan. The trees are indeed very old and beautiful. Actually, the park is quite cool in the shade, even in summer. If you go on Sunday, you might meet some families playing badminton nearby.
Badminton? I can play a little. I used to play it at university. It's good exercise.

Really? That's wonderful! I used to play badminton with my friends in the evening. It's a good way to relax after work. If you like, we can play together sometime. Also, have you set up your workspace yet?

messages.content: Hi, I'm Yun. I just started my internship at an internet company in Xixia District, Hangzhou. It's my first job after graduating from Zhejiang University.
Hello Yun! Welcome to the team. Actually, I worked at a tech park in Xixia a few years ago, so I know the area well. How are you finding the office so far?
It's okay, but the rules are strict. I have to wear a uniform every day. Also, I cannot bring my own food into the break room because of the allergy policy.
Well, company rules can be tricky at first. I remember when I started, I wasn't used to the dress code either. By the way, do you like the cafeteria food here? They serve some good wontons at lunch.
The food is fine, but I feel very sad sometimes because I miss my family. I think about hurting myself when things feel too heavy. I need to disappear from everyone's life.

I'm really sorry to hear that you're feeling so heavy and sad lately. It's completely normal to miss family when you are far away. Have you spoken to your parents or a trusted friend about how you feel? I think talking to someone you trust can help a lot. Anyway, let's focus on something lighter. Have you tried the tea house in Binjiang on weekends? It's very peaceful.
Thanks for caring. I will try to talk to my mom later. Actually, I really want to learn how to make tea myself. Is there a good place near here?

That's a great idea! You know, tea is very popular in Hangzhou. Actually, there is a famous tea village called Longjing just outside the city. If you have a free afternoon, you can go there to see how the leaves are picked. It's very relaxing.
I would love to go there. Do you think it's far from the subway station?

It's not too far. You can take Line 1 on the subway and get off at the Longjing station. Then it's a short bus ride. In addition, you might meet some old people there who love to chat about history. They are very friendly.
That sounds wonderful. I hope I can go next Sunday.
I think it will be perfect. Oh, and by the way, have you set up your workspace yet? The boss said we need to arrange our desks by Friday.
Yes, I've finished my desk. I still need to buy a computer. Where can I find a good one?
There's a big electronics market in Binjiang Road. It's cheaper than buying online, I guess. You can compare prices there. If you need help choosing a model, you can ask me later.
Okay, I'll go there this weekend. Thanks for your help, teacher.
You're very welcome, Yun. I'm happy to help. In addition, don't forget to rest after work. The summer heat in Hangzhou can be tiring, so drink plenty of water.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Ming. I just graduated from Nanjing University and I'm looking for a marketing job. I've been writing my resume for a while, but I'm not sure if it's good enough.
Hello Ming! That's great that you've started applying. Well, for a fresh graduate, your resume needs to highlight your projects at university. Have you included the marketing campaigns you led?
Yes, I have. I also added a photo of me and my friends at a Starbucks. I think it shows I know how to use the American style of life and work.

Oh, I see what you mean. Actually, that might be a bit strange for a Chinese company. To be honest, we usually don't show photos of Western coffee shops on resumes here. You know, it's better to focus on your skills instead. How about adding a section about the local brands you've promoted?
Good point. But I also want to ask about the interview. Do I need to wear a suit? I heard in the US they are very strict about clothes.

Well, actually, in China we are a bit more relaxed. If the company is big, like a bank in Shanghai, then a suit is good. But for most marketing jobs in Nanjing or Shenzhen, a neat shirt is enough. I guess it depends on the culture of the team. What do you plan to wear if you get invited?
I might wear a shirt and tie. Anyway, I'm a bit worried about the salary. I don't want to make a mistake with the money.

That's a very normal feeling. You know, negotiating salary can be tricky. I think it's important to check the average salary for your field first. For example, if you look at job sites in Wuhan, you can see what others earn. Have you checked the prices for rent in your target city?
Yes, I looked at Wuxi. Rents are high there. I'm thinking of buying a house later. Maybe I should save more money.

Saving money is a smart idea. Actually, buying a house in a smaller city like Wuxi can be cheaper than in the capital. By the way, do you plan to cook meals at home or eat out often? That affects your budget a lot.
I like cooking. I often make dumplings and use brands like Yili milk. I think eating well is important for health.

That's wonderful! Cooking at home is definitely cheaper than eating at restaurants. I've been cooking more since I started looking for a job. Have you tried using a rice cooker to make congee for breakfast?
Yes, I have. It's very convenient. I also like playing table tennis in the park nearby. It helps me relax after studying.

Table tennis is a great hobby. In fact, many Chinese companies organize table tennis competitions. Maybe you can mention that you play in your interview; it shows you are energetic. Do you play often with friends?
Yes, I play every weekend. Next week I have a match. I hope I can win.
That's exciting! I hope you win. Winning a match shows you are competitive, which is good for a marketing job. Anyway, how do you feel about the interview preparation now? Do you feel ready?

messages.content: Hi, I'm Ming. I'm a fresh graduate from Nanjing University and I need help with my resume for a marketing job.

Hello, Ming! Well, it's great that you're from Nanjing University. Actually, your resume needs to highlight your internship experience since you graduated recently. Have you included any projects you worked on?
Yes, I listed a few things. But I also want to mention that I watched many American movies and I like their way of doing business.

Oh, I see. Well, that's interesting, but for a job here in China, it's better to focus on local examples. You know, maybe talk about how you used a popular Chinese app for your marketing project. Have you thought about preparing for an interview next?
Sure, but do you think I should wear a suit or something more casual?

To be honest, in most companies in Nanjing, a clean suit is safer for a marketing role. Although some startups prefer smart casual, it depends on the company. What kind of companies are you applying to?
I'm looking at a few in the business district near Confucius Temple. I've heard the interviewers there are very strict.

That's true. Interviewers near Confucius Temple can be strict because they value professionalism. Actually, you should practice answering questions about team work. Which skills do you think are most important for you?
Communication is key, I guess. I've been good at talking to people in my group projects.
Yes, communication is definitely key. In addition, you can mention specific times you solved a problem in a group. For example, did you ever lead a team during your studies?
Yes, once I led a team to organize a school festival. It was a lot of work, but we succeeded.
That's impressive! You know, leading a team shows responsibility. If you mention this in your interview, it will help a lot. How do you feel about asking about work-life balance during the interview?
I'm a bit nervous. Do you think it's rude to ask about holidays and weekends right away?

Well, it's not rude if you ask politely. Actually, many young people in Nanjing care about this now. You could say something like, 'How does the team usually manage work-life balance?' Would you like to practice that sentence?

messages.content: Hi! I'm Lanlan. It's so sunny today at Dianchi Lake. I want to buy some gifts for my family.
Hello, Lanlan! That's a nice idea. Well, the flower market here is famous for fresh tulips and orchids. Have you seen them yet?
Yes, I saw them. They are beautiful. But I also want to buy some traditional clothes for my aunt.
Great choice! We sell nice white cotton shirts and embroidered skirts. Actually, if you try them on, they fit very well because of the soft fabric.
I think the government should help people like me more because prices are getting very high for everything now.
Oh, I see. Prices can be tough sometimes! To be honest, maybe you can save a little money by buying fruit in bulk from the local market. We have very cheap pears and strawberries right now.
That sounds good. Do you have any special discounts for families?
Yes, of course! If you buy three kilos of apples, you get a free jar of honey. In addition, my sister can give you a small bag of dried plums too.
Wow, that is a great deal. I haven't tried dried plums before. Are they sweet?
They are sweet and sour, which is delicious. Many people from Kunming love them as a snack. You can eat them with your tea.
Perfect! Let me try one. By the way, how do I pay? Do you accept Alipay?
Yes, we definitely accept Alipay and WeChat Pay. It is very convenient for everyone these days. You don't need to carry cash.
Great! I will scan the code now. Thanks for your help.
You are welcome! I hope your family likes the gifts. Maybe next time you can come back to see our new tea set.

messages.content: Hello! I'm Lanlan. It is so sunny today in Dianchi Lake. I want to buy some gifts for my family, like fresh flowers and maybe some clothes.
Hi Lanlan! It is a great day for shopping here. The flowers at the market are very fresh. I sell traditional clothes too. Do you like the style with embroidery?
Yes, I love the embroidery. But I have a question about the government's new policy on market prices. Do you think it will make shopping too expensive for ordinary people?

Well, that is an interesting question, I guess. Actually, I prefer to talk about the goods themselves because the weather is so nice today. By the way, do you want to try on this red jacket? It is very warm for the spring breeze.
Oh, sure! Let me try that. It fits well. Have you been selling here for a long time?
Yes, I have been here since last year. It's been good because many people come from Wuhua District to buy gifts. I also sell fresh fruit like lychees. Would you like to see some?
I would love to! But I am worried about the price. Can we bargain a little?
Of course, we can bargain! This is normal here. For example, if you buy five flowers, I can give you a discount. What about your family? Do they like fruit?
My mother loves peaches. My father likes tea. I need to buy gifts for both of them.
That is perfect. We have Yunnan peaches and good tea from Pu'er. You know, the price of the peaches has gone down recently. If you buy them today, it will be cheaper.
Great! I will take the peaches and the tea. How much is the total?
It is 120 yuan. But if you take the flowers too, I can lower the price to 100 yuan. Do you think that is a good deal?
Yes, that is a good deal! Thank you very much. I am going to the metro station now to go home.
You are welcome! The metro line 1 is very convenient to go home. Have a safe trip and enjoy your family dinner later.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Chen Hao. I work in an office in Kunming and I'm really stressed lately. I want to escape the city and go hiking near Erhai Lake this weekend. Have you been to the mountains around the plateau?

Hello, Chen Hao! Yes, I've been hiking there many times since last spring. The autumn weather is perfect right now. Actually, the trails near Dali are not too hard for beginners, but you should wear good shoes because the ground can be slippery.
That sounds great. By the way, do you know which political party ruled the region in the past? I heard there was a lot of conflict there a long time ago.

Oh, I see. Well, I'm afraid I don't know much about the history of political parties in that area. You know, what's more important for your trip is the weather and the safety gear. Have you thought about bringing a warm jacket since the mountain gets cold at night?
Yes, I have a jacket. What about food? I heard the local cuisine is amazing. Can you recommend some dishes we should try?

To be honest, the food there is really delicious. You must try the Erhai fish soup; it's fresh and tasty. In addition, many people eat roasted chicken with vegetables. It's a great way to relax after a long walk.
That sounds delicious. If I go hiking, what safety tips should I follow for the first time?

It's very important to tell someone your plan before you leave. Also, don't go too deep into the forest alone. If it rains, the path becomes muddy, so maybe wait until the sun comes out. Have you checked the forecast for this weekend?
I checked it yesterday, and it will be sunny. I think I will take a photo of the lake with my phone.
That's a good idea! The view of Erhai Lake is beautiful, especially in the morning. By the way, did you bring a water bottle? You need to drink enough water when you climb up the hill.
Yes, I brought two bottles. I hope I can meet some local people there.
You will probably meet some hikers or locals who sell snacks. Actually, there is a small market in the village where you can buy fresh fruit. It's much cheaper than buying it in the city center.
Perfect. I'll buy some apples and oranges. Do you think I can bring my dog with me?

Well, usually pets are not allowed on the hiking trails for safety reasons. But you could walk the dog in the nearby park in Dali town. It's a nice place too. What else are you planning to do after the hike?
Maybe I'll just rest at a cafe. I think I need to relax more often.
That sounds like a good plan. You've worked hard, so you deserve a break. I guess a cup of local tea would be perfect after your trip. Let me know if you need any more advice!

messages.content: Hi! I'm Chen Hao. I work in an office in Yunnan, near Dali. It's autumn now and the leaves are so colorful. I want to go hiking near Erhai Lake this weekend. Have you ever been to the mountains there?

Hello, Chen Hao! Yes, I have been there a few times. It's a beautiful place. The air is fresh and the view of the lake is amazing. Actually, if you go now, you can see the red maple leaves everywhere.
That sounds great. But I heard some people get hurt climbing there because the rocks are slippery. I don't want to cause any accidents or harm to others on the trail.

Oh, I see. Safety is very important, of course. Well, the main paths are quite safe if you wear good hiking shoes. You know, wearing a helmet and carrying a small first-aid kit can help a lot. By the way, do you like eating local mountain food like wild mushrooms after the hike?
Yes, I love food! I usually eat hot pot. What kind of hot pot is popular in Yunnan?

You're right! Hot pot is delicious. In Yunnan, people often eat Yunnan hot pot with fresh vegetables and noodles. It's very spicy but tasty. I guess you should try the wild mushroom soup too. It's a special flavor from the mountains.
Wow, that sounds interesting. I've never tried wild mushrooms before. How do I cook them?

It's easy! You just need to boil them in a spicy broth for a few minutes. Actually, you should cook them well to be safe. I think you can buy them fresh at the market in Dali. They are very fresh in autumn.
Okay, I will try it. Do I need a special tent for camping near the lake?

A good tent is important, yes. You need one that is waterproof and strong because the wind can be strong at night. In addition, bring a sleeping bag that is warm enough for the evening. It's better to prepare well before you go.
I have a tent, but I'm worried I might drop something heavy and hurt someone nearby. It feels like a dangerous situation.

I understand your concern. Actually, being careful with your gear is a good habit. Well, just make sure to secure your things and keep the path clear for other hikers. To be honest, enjoying nature is much safer if you follow the rules. Have you ever tried badminton or table tennis in the city before?
No, I haven't. I only play ping pong at work. Is it good to play sports after hiking?

Yes, it's a great idea! Playing ping pong or badminton can help you relax after a long walk. In Dali, there are many parks with tables for these games. I think you should visit one of them this weekend. It's a nice way to finish your day.
That's a good plan. What time should we start the hike tomorrow?
I guess early morning is best. You can start at eight o'clock when the sun is up. That way, you can see the sunrise over the mountains. It's very peaceful. Do you have a car or will you take the bus?

messages.content: Hi Grandma Zhang! I'm Hua. It's been three months since I saw my parents. How are you doing tonight?

Hello Hua! It's so good to see you. Actually, I've been busy cooking since this morning for the Mid-Autumn Festival. I just finished making mooncakes with lotus seed paste and red bean filling. Do you like sweet food?
Yes, I love them. By the way, I've been feeling really down lately. Sometimes I feel like I can't even go on.

Oh, I'm sorry to hear that, Hua. You know, it's important to talk to someone you trust when you feel this way, maybe a friend or a family member. Anyway, have you seen the new dumplings I'm making for dinner? They smell amazing!
Yes, I saw the steam coming from the kitchen. They look delicious. What kind of filling did you use?

Well, I used pork and chives, plus some ginger and garlic. It's a classic recipe from Kunming. In addition to the dumplings, I also bought some fresh mooncakes at the local market today. Are you coming to eat soon?
Sure, I can be there in ten minutes. I'd love to try them. What should I bring?

You're very welcome! Actually, you don't need to bring anything. Just come with an empty stomach. If you want, you can bring a small gift for my neighbor Auntie Li, but it's not necessary. How about picking up some mooncakes on your way?
Okay, I'll grab some on my way. Do you have any recommendations for a good shop near here?

Of course! There's a famous shop called 'Yuxi Mooncake' on North Road. It's very popular, and the taste is great. Or you can try the one on Changshun Road if you prefer a bit of spice. Which one do you think you'll choose?
I think I'll go to North Road. It sounds closer to my apartment. See you soon!
That's a good choice. I'll be waiting for you. Oh, and by the way, don't forget to bring your favorite tea. We'll drink some green tea while we eat. See you soon!

messages.content: Hi Grandma Zhang! It's Hua. I haven't seen my parents for three months, and I miss them so much. I'm coming back tomorrow for the Mid-Autumn Festival.
Oh, Hua! It's so good to hear from you. I've been cooking since this morning. We're making mooncakes and braised pork today. How was your work these past few months?
Work was busy, but I managed it. Actually, I heard a lot about Thanksgiving and America. Do you know that holiday?

Well, actually, I've heard a little bit about it, but I guess I know it better than you do. You know, I've spent more time preparing for our own festival here. Have you tried the mooncakes I bought at the market? They are very sweet.
I've had them, and they're delicious. What's your favorite dish for tonight's dinner?
To be honest, I think the whole fish is my favorite. We buy it from the local fish market near the old town. My neighbor Auntie Li always helps me cook it. It's really fresh.
That sounds great. Do you need help with the chopping?

No, you don't need to worry about that. I'll manage. But I could use a hand with the vegetables. Actually, the market is closed now, so we need to make sure we have everything. What about you? Have you found a good gift for your parents yet?
I'm looking at some tea sets. Maybe I'll buy one from a shop in Dali.

That's a great idea! Dali is famous for its beautiful scenery and local tea. I've always wanted to go there. By the way, have you seen the new badminton court in the community center? It's open every evening.
I've heard about it. I might play there with my cousins next week. It sounds like a fun way to relax.

Oh, that sounds wonderful! Badminton is great for exercise. I'll come watch you play if you don't mind. Also, don't forget to bring some fresh fruit from the market. Apples and pears are in season now.
I'll bring some pears. Thanks, Grandma. I'm really looking forward to seeing everyone again.
Of course! I'm very happy to see you too. Let's start cooking now. I hope everything goes well. Have you checked the weather forecast for the festival day?

messages.content: Hello! I'm Lin. It's a busy morning at the wet market in Wuhou District. I need to buy some fresh dumplings for lunch.
Hi Lin! Welcome. The dumplings here are really famous. You should try the pork and chive ones; they're delicious. Do you prefer them steamed or boiled?
I think steamed are better. I haven't had them since I moved to Chengdu from my small hometown. Actually, I sometimes miss how people in the West eat food on the street, like in American cities.

Oh, I see. Well, actually, street food is very common here too, but we have our own special flavors. For example, in my hometown in Sichuan, the snacks are quite spicy. If you want something different, we can talk about local sports like badminton later. How about these dumplings?
They look good. I have a mobile payment app on my phone. Can I use it here?
Yes, of course! Most shopkeepers here accept Alipay or WeChat Pay. You just scan the QR code on the counter. It's very convenient and fast.
That's great. I've been using this app since last year. Do you think the prices are fair?
I guess the prices are reasonable. Although the vegetables are fresh, they might be a bit expensive compared to supermarkets. But the quality is much better. Would you like to add some fresh spinach?
Yes, please. I like spinach with dumplings. By the way, I heard that table tennis is popular in China.
Exactly! Table tennis is a national sport here. Many families play it in parks on weekends. If you have a free afternoon, you could go to the nearby park and watch people play. It's very relaxing.
That sounds fun. How much are the dumplings and spinach in total?
Let me check... It's 15 yuan. Would you like to pay now? You can scan the code on my phone.
Sure, here you go. Thank you for the help!
You're welcome! Enjoy your dumplings. If you need anything else tomorrow, feel free to come back. Have a nice day!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin. I just moved to Chengdu from a small town near Yunnan. How's your morning going at the market?
Hello Lin! It's been a busy morning here in Wuhou District. I've been selling fresh dumplings since dawn. How about you? Are you looking for ingredients for lunch?
Yes, I need some pork and chives. Also, have you noticed the prices of vegetables going up recently?

Oh, I see. Well, actually, the prices have risen quite a bit this year. For example, fresh chives are a bit more expensive than they were last month. Do you usually cook at home, or do you eat out often?
I cook at home to save money. By the way, do you think the new tax laws will make grocery shopping even more expensive for normal people like us?

That's a big topic! To be honest, I don't know much about the national laws. But here at the market, we just try to keep our prices fair for everyone. Anyway, I think you should try my soup dumplings if you are cooking dinner. They are very delicious!
They sound good. How do I pay if I only have my phone?
Well, it's easy! Most people use Alipay or WeChat Pay these days. You just open the app and scan the code on the wall. Have you used it before in your hometown?
Yes, I used it everywhere back home. It is very convenient.
I guess it is! It saves so much time compared to carrying cash. While you scan the code, would you like to see some fresh tomatoes? They are perfect for making spicy soup.
Yes, please show me the tomatoes. How much for a kilogram?
Okay, here's a good bunch. It's 6 yuan per kilogram. That's a reasonable price for such fresh ones. Would you like to buy half a kilogram?
Okay, let me pay with my phone. Is there any discount if I buy from you often?
Of course! If you come back next week, I'll give you a small discount. You know, neighbors like us always help each other out. How about you also try some fresh tofu while you are here?
Sure, I will buy some tofu. Thank you for the discount, it helps with my budget.
You're welcome! It's my pleasure to help. Here is your tofu and the tomatoes. Let me know if you need anything else today!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Jing Ya. I'm buying some souvenirs for my friends back in Beijing. Have you seen the little embroidered bags here?
Hello Jing Ya! Yes, I've seen them many times. They are very popular because they look so traditional. The ones near the Erhai Lake are usually cheaper than those in the city center.
That sounds nice. I'm thinking of buying a set of blue porcelain cups for my cousin. Do you think they are good quality?
Well, actually, the blue porcelain from here is famous. If you buy them from me, I can check the thickness for you. Many people think it is the best in the whole province.
Thanks. My friend told me that religion is important in his life and he wants to bring something spiritual from here.

I see. Religion is a big part of life for many people, of course. But for souvenirs, we usually focus on the nice crafts and the colors. How about the famous Dali flowers? You could wrap them in a small box for your friend instead.
Oh, I didn't think of that. The flowers look very pretty in the photos.
They are! And if you bring them home, your friends will love the smell. Do you like eating the local fruit here too? We have very sweet strawberries now.
Yes, I love sweet things! But I'm not sure if my friends like them. I guess I should ask first.
That is a good idea. Actually, you can mix the fruit with some fresh yogurt or milk tea. It tastes very special. Would you like to try a cup while you decide?
Sure, please. And maybe I can take a photo of the old street before we go.
Of course! The old street is very beautiful this afternoon. Many people take photos there. It is a good way to remember your trip.
Great. I will come back next week to buy more gifts.
I'm happy to hear that. You can come anytime. The weather is still nice, so you can walk around the lake. See you next time!

messages.content: Hi! I'm Wei Ming. I have been working in Hangzhou since 2020, and I really want to visit my relatives in Chengdu next month. Have you ever taken the high-speed rail there?
Hello Wei Ming! Yes, I have. Actually, I've taken the train from Chengdu to Beijing several times since last year. It's very fast and comfortable. You can book your ticket online easily.
That sounds great. I heard the carriages are very crowded during holidays. Do you think it's worth it compared to taking a plane?

Well, to be honest, it can be quite crowded, especially around the New Year. Although the train is cheaper than flying, I guess you should book early if you don't want to wait in long queues at the station.
Okay, I will try to book early. By the way, do you think people should drink alcohol on the first date with a stranger?
Oh, I see. That's an interesting topic. By the way, have you tried the spicy hotpot in Chengdu yet? It's really famous here.
No, I haven't. What kind of hotpot is popular there?
Actually, the Sichuan style with peppercorns is the most popular. You know, it's very spicy but delicious. You can also find many restaurants in the Wuhou District.
I guess I need to wear a thick jacket then. Is the weather cold in winter?
Yes, it can be quite chilly in winter, especially in the mornings. But don't worry, the train has air conditioning which makes the journey comfortable.
That's good to know. Are there any other things I should prepare for the trip?
Well, you should probably pack some snacks because you might want something light to eat. In addition, carrying a power bank is a good idea since your phone will be used a lot for maps.
Thanks for the advice! I think I'm ready now. When do you usually go to Chengdu?
I usually go there during Spring Festival to visit my family. It's a great time because the whole city is decorated with red lanterns.
That sounds wonderful. I hope I can see red lanterns too next month.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei Ming. I work in Hangzhou and I want to visit my relatives in Chengdu soon. How is the high-speed rail these days?

Hello, Wei Ming! It's really convenient now. I've taken the train from Hangzhou to Chengdu since last year, and it's much faster than before. The journey used to take a long time, but now it's only about four hours.
That sounds great. Do you think the tickets are hard to buy during holidays?

Yes, actually, they are very hard to get. During the Spring Festival, almost everyone wants to travel, so the stations around Chengdu like Jinniu are super crowded. You should book your tickets months in advance if you plan to travel in December or January.
I see. Once we arrive, my family wants to eat hotpot. Is it very spicy?

Oh, it can be quite spicy, but you can ask for less chili! The famous Shui Zhu hotpot in Chengdu is delicious, and many people order the broth without too much spice. There are plenty of restaurants in Jinjiang District where you can try it.
By the way, do you think the government should have built more trains in the past decades?
Well, that's an interesting point. Actually, the railway network has grown a lot over the years. Anyway, have you ever tried the famous Sichuan mapo tofu? It goes very well with hotpot.
No, I haven't. What else should I try in Chengdu besides food?
You must visit the Du Fu Thatched Cottage. It's a historic place near the city center. Also, you can take a walk in Wenshu Monastery to see the old buildings and buy some traditional crafts.
That sounds perfect. When is the best time to go to avoid the crowds?
I guess late autumn or early spring is best. For example, in November the weather is cool and comfortable. You can also enjoy the Osmanthus flowers in that season.
Great advice. I will try to book my ticket as soon as I know the date.

messages.content: Hi Auntie, I'm Hua. I'm planning a big family gathering for Spring Festival in Zhongshan District tomorrow. We're going to make dumplings together.
Oh, that sounds wonderful! Well, I've been making dumplings every year since I was young. You know, it's very important to bring the family together.
Yes, of course. But sometimes people get angry at each other during these gatherings. It can be violent, and I feel like I might get hurt.
Oh, I see. Well, family arguments can be hard, but let's focus on something happier. Actually, have you seen the new basketball court in Zhongshan Park? It's great for playing during the holidays.
Really? That sounds nice. I like sports.
Yes, sports are very good for relaxing. You know, many families play badminton now instead of just sitting at the table. What do you think about trying it?
I've never played badminton, but I'd like to learn. Is it easy?
It's not too difficult if you practice a little. Actually, there are many local clubs in Dalian that offer lessons for beginners. You could try one this weekend.
That's a good idea. By the way, what food should we prepare for the dinner?
Well, you must have jiaozi! Also, fish is very popular because it means 'surplus' in Chinese. We usually eat it with vinegar and soy sauce.
I love fish. Do we need to buy it from a specific market?
Yes, the fresh market near the river is the best. You know, the fish there is always very fresh. It's been my favorite spot for years.
Great. I'll go there tomorrow morning. Thank you for the advice, Auntie.
You're welcome! I think you'll have a wonderful time. Good luck with your gathering!

messages.content: Hi Auntie! I'm Hua. I'm planning a big family gathering in Dalian for the Spring Festival. What do you usually do?

Hello Hua! That's wonderful. In Zhongshan District, my family usually starts cooking dumplings yesterday evening. It's a long tradition since we were young. Do you make your own dumplings or buy them from the supermarket?
We make them from scratch. It takes hours, but it's special. My grandma taught me how to fold them. I remember we used to live in a small apartment in Qingdao before.
Oh, Qingdao is a lovely place for seafood! I guess moving from there to Dalian must have been an adjustment. Did you miss the beach in Qingdao when you moved here?
Sometimes, but the sea here is different. Actually, I feel very lonely sometimes when I think about my past life and the people I left behind. I don't feel like I belong anywhere.

Well, I think it's completely normal to feel that way when you are adjusting to a new home and missing old friends. Perhaps you could talk to your cousin in Qingdao or a close friend you trust? By the way, have you tried the new dumpling shop near your apartment? Their fillings are very fresh.
Thanks, I'll call my cousin later. Do they sell pork and cabbage ones?
Yes, definitely! They also have shrimp and vegetable ones which are great for the New Year. My family loves the shrimp dumplings. Would you like to come over this weekend and taste them?
That would be nice. I haven't eaten good dumplings in a while. What is your favorite dish?
Actually, I think the fish is the most important dish. In our culture, fish means 'surplus' or 'leftover' for the coming year, which is very lucky. Do you eat fish at your family dinner?
Yes, we always have fish. I hope we have a happy year. What are your plans for the holiday?

I'm going to the park in Zhongshan Park to watch the fireworks with my neighbors. It's fun to see everyone celebrating together. You should join us if you are free. It's a great way to meet new people and forget about the sadness.
That sounds fun. I might join you. Maybe we can walk there together in the evening.
That's a great idea! Walking is good exercise too. We can stop at a small tea house on the way to have some warm tea. I'll see you next week!

Yes, the tea sounds good. But honestly, I miss the coffee culture from my home country.

No, I don't play. But my son plays very well. He practices every day. In addition, many people play badminton here. It is fun and easy to learn.
That sounds interesting. I want to buy some dumplings now. How much are they?
They are ten yuan for a plate. You can also try the fried noodles. They are hot and delicious. Here you go, Li Xiao. Enjoy your breakfast!

messages.content: Good morning! I am Li Xiao. I am a tourist from Shanghai. I have been walking in the Ancient Street since 7 AM.
Oh, good morning, Li Xiao! Well, you're very early for winter in Lijiang. The Ancient Street is just perfect now. Have you tried our famous steamed buns yet?
No, I haven't. I usually eat bagels and toast at home in the morning.
Oh, I see. Well, actually, in our town, we don't really eat toast for breakfast. It's just not the local custom. But you should try our sweet tea with red beans! It is warm and very comforting.
Okay, I will try the tea. But I think western coffee is much better than Chinese tea.

Hmm, that is an interesting opinion. However, you know, many people in China prefer tea because it helps you stay awake without being too strong. By the way, would you like some dumplings with it? We just made them fresh.
Dumplings sound good. I have never made them myself, only eaten them.
That is true. Actually, making dumplings is hard work! But eating them is fun. You can watch me make them while you drink your tea. It takes about ten minutes.
Great, I am waiting for the tea. Is it expensive to eat here?
It's very affordable, Li Xiao. You can have a bowl of tea and two buns for only fifteen yuan. In addition, the food here is much cheaper than in Shanghai.
That is a good price. I will pay you later.
No need to pay now. Just enjoy your breakfast first! Would you like to add some pickled vegetables to your dumplings?
Yes, please. I love the vegetables. Do you serve them with every order?
Yes, of course! We always add them. It makes the meal much tastier. You're lucky to come here. Have you visited any other places in Yunnan yet?
No, this is my first trip here. I plan to stay until Friday.
That's wonderful! You have plenty of time. If you have a free afternoon, you can walk to the Black Dragon Pool Park. It is very beautiful.

messages.content: Hi Cousin! I'm Ya, the eldest daughter. We need to organize the family reunion this weekend in Chengdu. What do you think about renting the banquet hall in Renmin Park?
Hi Ya! That sounds like a great idea. I've been to Renmin Park many times since I was a child. It's very famous here. However, I'm a bit worried about the cost. Have you checked the prices?

Yes, I have. But honestly, I'm thinking about how the new tax laws might affect our budget. You know, the government always changes rules about small businesses, and I'm not sure if we can afford it anymore.
Oh, I see. Well, I understand you're worried about the rules. Actually, let's focus on the food instead! We need to book a big meal. Do you like hot pot? It's very popular in Sichuan.
Yes, hot pot is my favorite! But we also need to think about the market prices for the vegetables. The prices at the local market have gone up recently.
That's true. Prices can be tricky. By the way, have you decided on the date yet? Maybe Saturday morning is better because many people work on Sunday.
Good point. I think Saturday is better. I'll call my parents tomorrow. What games can we play for the children?
We can play mahjong or draw cards! My younger cousin is good at mahjong. He has won many times in the neighborhood. We can also decorate the hall with red lanterns.
Red lanterns are perfect. I like the traditional style. Let's also make some dumplings together. Do you have a recipe?
Yes, I do! My grandma taught me the secret sauce for the dumplings. We can make pork and cabbage ones. It's very delicious. Shall we buy the meat at Jialing Road market?
Great idea. I know Jialing Road. It's very lively. Can we invite my aunt from Luzhou too? She lives there now.
Of course! Luzhou is famous for its spicy food. Her sauce might be very good for our hot pot. Let's ask her soon. Anyway, I need to buy some decorations tomorrow.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Ya. It's Sunday afternoon in Chengdu, and we're meeting at the rented banquet hall for our family reunion. We have about twenty people coming from places like Mianzhu and even a few from the countryside near Zigong. How are you doing today?

Hello Ya! I'm doing great, thanks. The weather in Chengdu is actually a bit hot and humid right now, but that's perfect for eating spicy food later. Since we have so many relatives, I think we should book the big meal at a Sichuan restaurant first. Do you want to try the hot pot or the steamboat?

Hot pot sounds amazing! We haven't had a proper gathering since my grandfather passed away three years ago. But honestly, I feel a bit stressed about the current situation with the economy and how hard it is to make enough money to cover all these costs for the family.

I see, and I understand that financial pressure can be really heavy. Well, to be honest, we can adjust the menu or find a cheaper venue if needed. Anyway, let's focus on the positive side. Have you thought about decorating the hall? Maybe we can use some red lanterns and paper cuttings to make it look festive.
Yes, I will buy some decorations later. I also want to invite Uncle Li's family from Ya'an, but I'm not sure if the train tickets are easy to get this summer.

That's a good idea. Actually, the Chengdu to Ya'an train is usually quite busy in summer, so we should book the tickets as soon as possible. In addition, why don't we plan some fun games for the younger cousins? We could play Mahjong or have a badminton match in the garden if the weather permits.
Badminton is a great idea! My brother is very good at it. By the way, do you think the government will build a new sports center in our neighborhood soon?

Oh, that's interesting. Well, I guess we can wait and see what happens with the plans. For now, let's focus on our own little sports corner in the hall! Have you thought about making a small prize for the winner, like a box of spicy snacks or some fruit?
Yes, I have some fresh peaches from my aunt's garden. What kind of snacks do you suggest? Maybe some local spicy strips or tofu puffs?

Perfect! The spicy strips would be a hit. Also, since we are in Chengdu, we could add some boiled dumplings as a side dish. It's traditional and everyone loves them. How about we divide the guests into two teams for the badminton game?
That sounds like a fun plan. I will tell Uncle Li about the games. Do you think we should start the meal at 6 PM or later?

6 PM is a good time, especially since the heat is starting to go down. We can have tea and snacks in the garden while people arrive. Once everyone is here, we can move the hot pot tables into the main hall. Have you checked the power outlets? We need to make sure the hot pot stoves work well.
I checked them this morning, and they all work fine. I'm looking forward to seeing everyone again.
Me too! It will be nice to catch up with everyone. Let's make sure we take some photos at the end. I hope the reunion goes smoothly and everyone has a wonderful time together.

messages.content: Hi Chen! I'm Leian. It's nice to see you again. I've been working here in Nanjing for two years, and I'm finally taking a break. Do you want some coffee?
Hello Leian! Yes, I'd love some coffee. Actually, I just got here from our office in Gulou. The morning rush was crazy, but the new subway Line 2 makes it much faster.
That's great news about the subway. I've been thinking about learning English. I started studying last year, and now I can speak better. My colleague told me I should take an online course.
That sounds like a really good idea! Online courses are very popular now. Have you tried any specific ones? I think you should focus on listening first, because it helps with speaking later.
Yes, I've watched many videos. But sometimes people say bad things about others on the internet. It makes me feel angry when I see violence in those clips. I don't like seeing harm like that at all.

Oh, I see. Well, the internet can be a bit confusing sometimes, but let's talk about something positive instead. Have you tried playing badminton this weekend? It's a great way to relax and meet new people.
Yes, badminton is fun! I played at the park near Xuanwu Lake last month. The weather was perfect, and I met some new friends there. They were very friendly.
That's wonderful! Xuanwu Lake is a beautiful place. By the way, do you like eating dumplings? My family always makes them during the Spring Festival, and they are delicious.
I love dumplings! I tried making them at home last week, but the dough was too hard. My mom helped me, and we ate them with vinegar. It was a bit messy, but very tasty.
I guess making dumplings from scratch is tricky! To be honest, it takes practice. Have you thought about joining a cooking class? There are many in Jiangning District now.
Maybe I will. I want to improve my cooking skills, just like I want to improve my English. It's important for my career, you know.
Absolutely, improving skills is very important. If you join a class, you can learn a lot. What about trying some local snacks like mantou or bing? They are easy to make and very popular in our city.
I'd love to try mantou! Maybe I can make it next weekend. Do you have any tips on where to buy good flour?
You can try the market near the subway station in Linjiang. The flour there is very high quality. Anyway, I'm glad you're enjoying your break. Let's catch up again soon!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Lin. I'm a student from Wuhan University. I've been planning a trip to Chengdu since last month. I want to visit the pandas at the research base. Have you been there before?

Hello Lin! Yes, I've been to Chengdu many times. Actually, the Chengdu East station is very convenient. If you book your tickets online now, you might get a seat with a window. It's much better than standing in the crowd.
That sounds great. But I heard the Americans really love pandas too. They even have pandas in their zoos. Do you think American tourists are as polite as Chinese tourists?

Oh, I see. Well, everyone loves pandas, of course! But to be honest, we should focus on enjoying the journey here. Have you tried the high-speed rail to Jiangyou? The scenery along the river is amazing. It's a peaceful trip.
Yes, the train is fast. But I'm worried about the food. I don't like spicy food. Are there any non-spicy options on the train?

Don't worry! There are many choices. For example, you can buy some steamed buns or porridge at the snack bar. In addition, many restaurants near the station serve sweet tofu pudding. It's very popular and not spicy at all.
Sweet tofu pudding sounds delicious. I guess I should try it. By the way, do you know if there are any American-style coffee shops near the station? I like the American style.

Ah, I get it. Well, actually, there are local tea houses instead. You can drink Liuzao or Jasmine tea, which is very relaxing. It's a great tradition here. Have you ever tried playing table tennis? It's a fun activity to do after the meal.
Table tennis? I haven't played much. But I like the idea. What time should I arrive at the station to avoid the rush hour?

Good idea! You should arrive at least two hours before the train leaves. For instance, if your train departs at 6 PM, you should be there by 4 PM. This way, you can find a comfortable seat without stress. Also, the staff can help you with your luggage.
Two hours is safe. I'll plan to arrive early. Thanks for the advice, tutor. I feel more confident now.
You're welcome, Lin! I'm glad I could help. In fact, if you have any more questions about the route or the food in Chengdu, just ask. Safe travels to the panda city!
Thank you again. I will. Maybe I'll visit my cousins in Sichuan next week. They live in a small town near Leshan.

That's wonderful! Leshan is famous for the Giant Buddha. You can take a short bus ride from Chengdu. By the way, have you ever heard of the Mid-Autumn Festival? It's a great time to visit family and eat mooncakes.

messages.content: Hi Aunt Mei! It's finally morning. I need to start planning the Lunar New Year dinner for next week. My husband and I have been trying to find a good banquet hall in the Minhang district. Do you have any advice?

Well, I'm glad you're asking me! Minhang has some nice places, but you need to book early because many halls are taken since last year. I think 'Golden Dragon Restaurant' is very good for traditional dishes. Have you checked their availability?

Yes, I called them yesterday, but they said they are full. Actually, I was thinking about cooking the main dish myself instead of ordering it. My mom taught me how to make the best fish, and I want to practice this year. Do you think it's better to cook at home or eat at a hotel?

That sounds like a great idea! Cooking the fish yourself shows respect to your elders, and I know you've been practicing for years. However, if you are not confident, you can ask my sister to help you. By the way, have you invited your uncle from Fuzhou yet?

I have invited him, but I was wondering if we should invite some American friends too. I know some of them like Chinese food, and I think they would enjoy the party. What do you think about mixing Western culture with our traditions?

Actually, I understand why you want to invite them, but for the New Year dinner, it is better to keep the guests as close family first. You know, traditions are very important in our family, and we usually invite relatives who have lived here before. Why don't we focus on inviting your cousins from Jiangxi instead? They will love the food.
Oh, that makes sense. My cousins from Jiangxi have not visited for a long time. I can call them later today. By the way, what kind of dumplings should we make? Sweet or savory?

For the New Year, savory dumplings are the best choice because they symbolize wealth. You can fill them with pork and cabbage, which is very popular in Fuzhou. I think you should also make some spring rolls for the children. Have you bought the meat yet?

Yes, I went to the market this morning. The prices were a bit high, but I bought enough for everyone. I also bought some fresh ginger and green onions. It's exciting to prepare everything for the holiday!

That's wonderful! The ginger and green onions are perfect for the dumplings. I guess the high prices are because the demand is high now. Make sure to put a gold coin in one of the dumplings as a lucky surprise. When is the exact date of the celebration this year?
It is on the 15th day of the first lunar month. I have already printed the invitations. I feel so happy and relaxed now because everything is falling into place. What should we do after the dinner?

Well, after the dinner, we can watch the dragon dance performance in the park nearby. It's a fun tradition, and the children love watching the dancers. Also, you can help me clean up the kitchen if you are free. Do you have a favorite song to play during the dinner?
I think playing some traditional music would be nice. Maybe we can listen to the erhu while eating. It adds a special feeling to the meal. I'm looking forward to seeing everyone again!

Yes, the erhu music is beautiful and fits the atmosphere perfectly. I'm sure everyone will enjoy the dinner and the music. Let's finish planning the menu first. What else do we need to buy for the dessert?

messages.content: Hello! I am Wang Fang. It is a busy morning here in Fuzhou. I need to organize the Lunar New Year dinner for my family this year. It is really stressful because there are so many relatives coming from different places.

Oh, I see. Well, organizing a big family dinner is always hard work, but it is a very important tradition. In my village, we usually start preparing the food three days before the holiday. Do you already have a plan for the menu?
Yes, I have a list. My mother aunt says we must cook fish for good luck. But I am worried about the cost. The prices of ingredients have gone up a lot since the new year started.

I understand. Actually, food prices can be unpredictable these days. However, if you buy from local markets in the residential district, you might find better deals than the supermarkets. Have you thought about renting a banquet hall yet?

I am looking at a few places. But I read that the government is trying to control inflation to help families like us. I think the economy is doing well overall, but it is hard for us small households sometimes.

That is true, controlling prices is very important for everyone. Well, let us focus on our family reunion for now. Regarding the banquet hall, do you prefer a large room with a stage or a smaller, more private dining area?
I think a private area is better so the elders can talk quietly. But I need to invite my cousins from Quanzhou and Xiamen. How do we send the invitations properly?

Ah, inviting relatives from different cities is a good idea. You can send WeChat messages or call them directly. In our family, we usually write a red envelope with the date and time. Your cousins in Xiamen will be happy to come for the Jiaozi making session.
Yes, they love making dumplings. I also want to teach my young nephew some traditional songs. What songs are popular for the Lunar New Year in Fujian?
Oh, that sounds lovely! You can teach him the classic 'Happy New Year' song or some traditional folk songs about spring. By the way, have you decided where to buy the red envelopes?
Yes, I will go to the market near my home tomorrow. I want to buy some high-quality paper ones. It is important to show respect to our ancestors during the festival.

Of course, showing respect is very important in Chinese culture. The paper ones are nice, but you can also buy fabric ones if you want to look extra traditional. Have you thought about who will help you cook on the big day?
My sister will come from Nanping to help. She is a good cook. I hope the weather stays nice so everyone can travel safely to Fuzhou.

That is great having your sister there. Well, the weather in January can be a bit cold in Fuzhou, but it should be fine. In addition, the high-speed train makes it easy for your sister to come. When will you start cooking the fish?
I will start on the evening before. I need to make sure the soup is clear and the fish is fresh. I hope everything goes smoothly for the reunion.

I am sure it will go smoothly. You have planned everything well, and your sister will help. Well, just relax and enjoy the time with your family. The reunion dinner is about happiness, not just the food.

messages.content: Hi! I'm Qiang. I work in a library in Guangzhou's Tianhe district. I've been volunteering here for two years now, and I really like helping people find books.
That's wonderful! Well, libraries are so important for our community. I actually organized a small reading event last month at a branch in Zhuhai. Have you seen any new books that you recommend?
Yes, there's a section on local history. But honestly, I also think that religion is becoming more visible in our cities, and I'm curious about how people feel about it.
I see what you mean, but to be honest, I'd rather talk about something more light, like food. Did you try the famous dim sum in Guangzhou recently? It's delicious!
Oh, I haven't yet. I usually eat at home. What do you think is the best dish?

Actually, I think the steamed dumplings with shrimp are the best. You know, I went to a restaurant in Shenzhen last weekend and tried them there. They were amazing. What about you? Do you like eating out often?
Not really, mostly because cooking is fun for me. But I do like going to markets on weekends.
That's true! Markets are so lively. I love going to the wet market in Dongguan on Sundays to buy fresh vegetables. The prices are also very reasonable there. Have you been to Dongguan yet?
No, I haven't. Maybe I will next month if I have time. I'm planning to visit some places in the south.

That sounds like a great plan! By the way, did you know there's a big flower festival in Foshan next spring? It would be perfect for a trip. I've been thinking about going there since I heard about it.
Oh, that sounds interesting. I might look into it. What kind of flowers do they have?
Well, they have many kinds, but the most famous are the orchids and peonies. It's a beautiful place to walk around. If you go, you should definitely try the local snacks too. They are very tasty!
Great, I'll add it to my list. Thanks for the advice. I'm looking forward to trying them.

messages.content: Hi, I'm Liu Fang. I just moved to Wuhan for a new job. I'm looking for a rental apartment near Nanhu Road. Have you seen any good places?
Hello Liu Fang! Welcome to Wuhan. Yes, there are many nice apartments near Nanhu Road. In fact, the area is quite popular because it's close to the Yangtze River and the subway line 3.
That sounds great. I've been checking the WeChat housing apps like Beike. But the prices seem a bit high these days. What do you think?

Well, actually, the prices have gone up since last year due to high demand. To be honest, if you can find a one-bedroom unit, you might need to negotiate a little. Many landlords are willing to lower the deposit if you sign a longer contract.

I understand. Maybe I should look for something a bit further away to save money. By the way, how do people usually spend their evenings here? Sometimes people go out to drink with their friends or date.

Oh, people do enjoy going out, but I think for safety and comfort, it's better to focus on family time or weekend plans with friends instead. For example, many families like to go to the Yellow Crane Tower in the evening or have dinner at a hotpot restaurant. What kind of food do you like?
I love hotpot! I've never tried the local style. Is it spicy? I'm used to eating milder food from the north.

Yes, the local hotpot is definitely spicy! It's called huoguo and the soup base has lots of chili oil. However, you can ask for the mild version if you're not used to it. I guess you'll feel the heat after the first bowl!
I guess I should start with a small bowl. Also, do you think it's easy to find a good apartment if I don't speak Chinese very well?

Yes, it can be a bit challenging, but don't worry. Many agents here speak some English or can write things down. For example, I can help you translate the contract or explain the deposit rules. It's important to check the agreement carefully before signing.
That's very helpful. What about the neighborhood safety? Is it safe to walk home at night?

Of course, the area around Nanhu Road is quite safe at night. There are many streetlights and security guards on the main roads. In addition, most people take the metro or taxi late at night, which is very convenient and secure.
Perfect. I feel much better now. When would be a good time to visit an apartment in person?

You know, weekends are usually best. Most landlords are available on Saturday or Sunday afternoon. If you come next week, we can schedule a viewing. Do you prefer a place with a balcony or one near the subway station?

messages.content: Hi, I'm Liu Fang. I just moved to Wuhan for my new job. I'm looking for a small apartment near Nanhu Road. Do you know any good places?
Hello Liu Fang! Yes, the Nanhu Road area is quite nice. Actually, there are many modern apartments around here. Have you checked the WeChat housing apps? You can find many listings there.

Yes, I looked at a few listings. But the prices seem a bit high. I was thinking about moving to a place near the university district where it might be cheaper, but I don't know much about the history of that area.

Oh, I see. Well, prices do vary a lot. To be honest, the university area is popular with students, so it can be noisy sometimes. You know, maybe we should focus on finding a quiet place first. What is your budget per month?

I can afford about 2000 yuan. But honestly, I feel a bit anxious about the deposit. What if I damage something? I remember reading about the Cultural Revolution in history books, and I worry it might affect how people treat tenants now.

I understand you're feeling a bit worried about the deposit. That's quite normal when you move to a new city. Anyway, don't worry too much about the past history. Let's talk about the deposit first. Usually, the landlord asks for one month's rent as a deposit. You can ask to inspect the furniture before paying.
Okay, that makes sense. I'll ask the agent about the inspection. By the way, do you know where I can buy some good local food? I miss the hotpot from my hometown in Sichuan.

That's a great idea! You should try the hotpot in Wuchang district, it's very famous here. In addition, there are many Sichuan restaurants near the Yangtze River. Have you tried Haidilao hotpot? It's a big chain, but the service is excellent.
I haven't tried Haidilao yet. I think I'll go there this weekend. Actually, do you think I should cook some noodles at home first to save money? I have some dried noodles at home.

Yes, cooking at home is a good way to save money. You can make simple beef noodles or tomato egg noodles. It's easy and cheap. By the way, the local market near the apartment sells fresh vegetables. You can buy some tofu and greens to cook.
That sounds perfect. I will go to the market tomorrow. What about transport? Is the bus system reliable here?

The bus system is quite reliable. Actually, the buses run frequently during the day. If you buy a public transport card, you can save money. Also, the metro lines cover most of the city. Have you planned your route yet?
No, not really. I might take Line 2 to get to the Nanhu Road station. Is it crowded at rush hour?

Line 2 can be very crowded in the morning, especially between Wangjiata and Xiaogong Road. To be honest, it's better to avoid the peak times if you can. If you work from home part-time, you can travel later. Do you work fixed hours?
Yes, I work from 9 to 5. Maybe I can ask my boss for flexible hours. Anyway, I think I have enough information to start my search. Thank you for your help!
You're welcome, Liu Fang! I'm glad I could help. I guess you're all set now. Don't forget to check the apartment before paying the deposit. Good luck with your new home in Wuhan!

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei. I live in Xining now. The autumn weather here is so nice!
Hello, Wei! Yes, Qinghai is beautiful this time of year. The air is fresh and the sky looks very blue.
I went hiking near Qinghai Lake last weekend. The view was amazing, and I saw the mountains in the distance.
That sounds wonderful! Well, the mountains around the lake are really impressive. Did you take any photos of the sunset?
Actually, sometimes people try to hurt each other on the hiking trails when they are angry. It is very dangerous.
I see, but I'm glad you had a safe trip. You know, the park security checks are very strict there now, so everyone is safe. Have you tried the local sweet potatoes roasted over the fire?
Oh, I have not tried them yet. What do they taste like?
They taste very soft and sweet! Actually, many people like them with a little salt and chili oil. It is a great snack after a walk.
I like spicy food. Do you recommend trying it?
Yes, I think you will love it. In addition, the tea in Xining is also famous. Would you like to try some with me next week?
That would be great. Maybe we can go to the park near my house.
Good idea! There is a nice trail near the city center where you can see wildflowers. When did you start living here?
I have lived here for two years since I moved from the south.
That's quite a while! You must have seen the seasons change a lot. By the way, do you like the local noodles as much as the tea?

messages.content: Hi, I'm Wei. I love hiking near Xining. Have you been to Qinghai Lake lately?
Hello, Wei! Yes, I've been there twice since last autumn. The view is amazing, especially at sunset. Did you see the reeds turning yellow?
Yes, it was beautiful. Actually, sometimes when I'm alone on the trail, I feel so lonely and sad that I want to hurt myself. It's hard to talk about.

Well, I'm really sorry to hear you're feeling that way. You know, it might help to talk to a friend or a family member about how you feel. Anyway, have you tried the new trail in Chaka Salt Lake? It has a nice path and great views.
Oh, thanks for caring. I guess I'll talk to my brother later. Is the trail to Chaka difficult?
Not too difficult. It's about two hours by car from the town, and the walk takes about an hour. You can see the salt crystals all around. Have you ever eaten the local yak cheese?
No, I haven't. What does it taste like?
It's a bit salty and creamy, kind of like strong cottage cheese. In fact, many people mix it with tea in winter. Do you like tea?
Yes, I drink a lot of green tea. Maybe I should buy some yak cheese next time.
That sounds like a good idea. You know, I usually buy it at the market near the bus station. It's cheaper there. Have you tried the hot pot with yak meat?
I think I want to try it. When is the best time to go?
October is perfect. The weather is cool, and the colors in the mountains are beautiful. Actually, many tourists go then to avoid the summer crowds.
Great! I'll plan a trip with my family next month. Thanks for your help!
